question: Can you provide the top 9 directors by movie count, including their ID, name, number of movies, average inter-movie duration (rounded to the nearest integer), average rating (rounded to 2 decimals), total votes, minimum and maximum ratings, and total movie duration? Sort the output first by movie count in descending order and then by total movie duration in descending order.
sql:
WITH director_movies AS (
    SELECT 
        dm.name_id,
        n.name,
        m.year,
        m.duration,
        r.avg_rating,
        r.total_votes,
        LAG(m.year) OVER (PARTITION BY dm.name_id ORDER BY m.year, m.id) as prev_year,
        m.year - LAG(m.year) OVER (PARTITION BY dm.name_id ORDER BY m.year, m.id) as year_diff
    FROM director_mapping dm
    JOIN names n ON dm.name_id = n.id
    JOIN movies m ON dm.movie_id = m.id
    JOIN ratings r ON dm.movie_id = r.movie_id
),
director_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        name_id,
        name,
        COUNT(*) as movie_count,
        SUM(duration) as total_duration,
        AVG(avg_rating) as avg_rating,
        SUM(total_votes) as total_votes,
        MIN(avg_rating) as min_rating,
        MAX(avg_rating) as max_rating,
        AVG(year_diff) as avg_inter_movie_duration
    FROM director_movies
    GROUP BY name_id, name
)
SELECT 
    name_id,
    name,
    movie_count,
    ROUND(avg_inter_movie_duration) as avg_inter_movie_duration,
    ROUND(avg_rating, 2) as avg_rating,
    total_votes,
    min_rating,
    max_rating,
    total_duration
FROM director_stats
ORDER BY movie_count DESC, total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9
